incidents.name: USPD StabilizerNFT clandestine proxy initialization
incidents.lossOther: 236.84 stETH + 302,909 USDC, against 98.45M unbacked USPD minted
incidents.notes: The StabilizerNFT ERC-1967 proxy was deployed uninitialized in its own transaction and initialized 12 seconds later by an attacker who took DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and UPGRADER_ROLE and installed a clandestine implementation behind a spoofed Upgraded event, and 79 days later that retained upgrade right was used to swap in a purpose-built implementation that minted 98.45M unbacked USPD against a flash-loaned deposit and drained 236.84 stETH from the position escrows plus 302,909 USDC from the USPD/USDC pool.

sources.ref: onchain review (Ethereum). Victim: StabilizerNFT ERC1967Proxy 0x1346b4d6867a382b02b19a8d131d9b96b18585f2, created 2025-09-16T13:01:59Z block 23375794 by the USPD deployer 0x555350445E1f1ca212edB8cF397a383695ff7a36 in tx 0x3477bb4cb7cfcd12664ca224ad8468cfe2168fa1e779333c847a02bea1623d23 — not the attacker and not the exploit-tx sender 0x083379bdac3e138cb0c7210e0282fbc466a3215a, so rule 2 holds. Note that public write-ups label 0x11a880b0c9d50b4aef7527d458497e60fa602429 the 'proxy contract'; onchain that address is the audited StabilizerNFT *implementation* (24 KB of runtime code, same deployer), so the row uses the proxy. Timeline from the proxy's Upgraded logs plus eth_getStorageAt on slot 0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc: 2025-09-16T13:01:59Z block 23375794 creation -> 0x11a880b0... ; 2025-09-16T13:02:11Z block 23375795 tx 0xc0b7e490caac2b8cfa5e62d1b28a5e7dba7600e623c71352acbc9b23c2b65b7c, sent by 0x7C97313f349608f59A07C23b18Ce523A33219d83 through Multicall3, front-runs the team's initialize(): it emits Initialized(1) and RoleGranted for DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and role 0x189ab7a9244df0848122154315af71fe140f3db0fe014031783b0946b8c9d2e3 to 0xc2a0ad4bd62676692f9dca88b750bec98e526c42, then Upgraded -> 0xac075b9bf166e5154cc98f62ee7b94e5345cc090 (clandestine implementation, itself deployed 2025-07-28 by unrelated CPIMP infrastructure 0xac82fa44b7e2c71db3931a47698de656ed6d2fca) followed by a second Upgraded in the same tx claiming 0x11a880b0... again — the slot really reads 0xac075b9b... at the end of that block, so the second event is spoofed; 2025-09-17T18:57:47Z block 23384737 the slot is silently restored to the audited 0x11a880b0... with no Upgraded event at all; 2025-12-04T12:35:23Z block 23939725 tx 0xe6715708c0e3b2b3a0a10ab1b25785b8d04db09ef71196c5ea313d8a0676f823 upgrades to 0x4c4eacbe5d5232698d12c379be14a0e561001c21, deployed 12 seconds earlier by the attacker; 2025-12-04T18:08:23Z the drain tx itself upgrades to 0xa3d2616ee942b36648eaa55976ee7b761bd2a21b (deployed by the attack sender ~6 minutes before). Age is measured from 2025-09-17T18:57:47Z, the last change to the victim's executing code that is not part of the attack's own execution: from that moment the audited implementation ran continuously for ~78 days. The two December implementation writes are the exploit machinery (contracts deployed by the attacker seconds before use) and are excluded; taking the December upgrade instead would give 19,980 s and measuring from deployment 6,843,984 s. verify.mjs, which takes the max Upgraded timestamp, would derive 0 s because the last Upgraded event is emitted inside the drain tx — hence the documented-change basis. Loss from the drain tx logs: 232.9651 + 3.7293 + 0.1485 = 236.8429 stETH to the attacker at stETH/USD 3153.719722543291 (curl https://coins.llama.fi/prices/historical/1764871703/coingecko:staked-ether; coingecko:ethereum reads 3153.449311643833 at the same timestamp) = $746,936, plus 302,908.86 USDC pulled out of the USPD/USDC pool 0x06cf5f9b93e9fcfdb33d6b3791eb152567cd8d36 = $1,049,845 total. The 3,121.95 WETH is a Balancer flash loan, repaid in the same tx; the 10 mint cycles issue 9,845,436.95 USPD each (98,454,369 USPD total) and the residual 1,621,355 USPD/USDC LP tokens the attacker keeps are backed by that unbacked USPD and are not counted.

incidents.documentedLastChange: 2025-09-17T18:57:47Z (block 23384737): the proxy's EIP-1967 implementation slot was silently restored to the audited StabilizerNFT implementation 0x11a880b0c9d50b4aef7527d458497e60fa602429 with no Upgraded event, ending the 33-hour window in which the attacker's clandestine implementation 0xac075b9bf166e5154cc98f62ee7b94e5345cc090 was the executing code; that audited code then ran unchanged until the attacker swapped in the purpose-built 0x4c4eacbe5d5232698d12c379be14a0e561001c21 on 2025-12-04T12:35:23Z as part of the drain
